title: THE AUSTRALIAN BEATLES
tickerText: Superbly reproducing the sights and sounds of the greatest band in history. From the early ‘Fab Four’  days with mop top hair and matching grey suits, through to ‘Beatle-mania’ and the ‘British Invasion’ of the USA.  And let’s not forget one of the most important albums ever recorded,  the astonishing psychedelic horizons of ‘Sgt. Pepper’ and then beyond to Abbey Road.
